entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: A ruined jungle shrine on Ixalan dedicated to the bat god Aclazotz.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Bat god, patron of vampirism, imprisoned deep in Ixalan's Core.

entities.name: High Marshal Arguel
entities.description: A vampire knight of the Legion of Dusk who rediscovered the temple.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Home of the Legion of Dusk.

events.summary: Guided by blood-fast visions, Arguel finds the temple entrance but Aclazotz, imprisoned in Ixalan's Core, does not answer.
events.quote: the bat god was imprisoned deep in Ixalan’s Core and did not answer

relations.quote: a vampire knight of the Legion of Dusk from Torrezon
is a ruined jungle shrine on the surface of Ixalan
